Hi Sarah / Mike —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we agreed to confirm: 

- Primary requirement: strict tenant/data isolation for PHI-adjacent telemetry and customer configs.
- Two candidate deployment modes under consideration: Dedicated (isolated GPU pools in Redwood managed infra) vs Private (VPC + customer-managed network or on-prem). Hosted API was ruled out for the telemetry path due to data residency.

Open items we said we would follow up on: 
1) KMS/Key custody options and what Redwood requires vs what can stay customer-managed.
2) Backup/snapshot handling and whether snapshots can be disabled or encrypted with customer keys.
3) Latency & throughput expectations for Dedicated vs Private for your 150 req/s baseline.
4) Compliance evidence checklist (SOC2 + network diagrams) you need for procurement.

Action items from us by EOD tomorrow: a short tradeoff matrix + a suggested technical agenda for a 60-min deep dive with our infra eng and your infra team. I’m attaching the matrix and a short notes PDF on KMS options.

Proposed next step: pick a time for the deep technical session (we can do Thu or Fri mornings PT). Please confirm availability and whether you want your security contact on the call.

Thanks,

Sarah — thanks, answers below and I’ve annotated the matrix attachment with these points.

- Dedicated + KMS: We support Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) for disk encryption at rest including snapshots for Dedicated. There are two options: Redwood holds a wrapped short-lived key and we encrypt with your CMK at rest, or the custodian (you) hold the root key in your KMS and we use envelope encryption. Details in redwood_private_kms_notes.pdf (see page 2).

- Private (VPC / on-prem) networking: For VPC deployments we do not require inbound public ports to your network — we establish mutually authenticated TLS tunnels to your control plane endpoint and route inference traffic over private endpoints. For on-prem there's a small control egress (HTTPS to our control plane) for orchestration; we can run fully air-gapped variants but that adds onboarding work (SOW item). I added a short network diagram link in the doc.

- SLA: Dedicated (reserved capacity) comes with a quota-backed latency target at the committed tier. The enterprise SLA (financial credits + 99.9% uptime target) is part of the Dedicated enterprise package — we can include that in the contract if you need it baked in. Hosted (public API) has different SLA tiers and isn’t recommended here.

Proposed deep-dive attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng, infra lead), Ben Carter (Sales Eng). We’ll plan 60 minutes: 20m infra deep-dive, 20m KMS/key management & backups, 20m Q&A + deployment timeline.

I’ve attached the annotated tradeoff matrix. If Thu AM PT still works, suggest Thu 09:30 PT. If you’d prefer Fri, we can do Fri 08:30 PT.
